pending_interview.category: Behavioral/leadership — conflict resolution, prioritization under ambiguity, influence without authority, giving hard feedback, scaling a team through change
pending_interview.question: You're leading an AI engineering team through a significant platform migration — moving from a legacy system to a new one that your engineers are excited about, but that your key internal client (a product team you serve) is skeptical of. Three months into the migration, the product team's lead comes to you and says the new platform is slowing down their feature velocity and they want to pause the migration and go back to the old system. You believe the migration is the right long-term decision and that the short-term slowdown is expected and temporary. How do you handle this conversation, and what do you do in the following two weeks?
